_about: Source of truth for the 2027 fact check (scripts/fact-check). Division data pulled read-only from Sports Connect (programs 80158833 baseball, 80158834 softball) on 2026-11-03; fees are the final 2027 fees (Jason, 2026-11-03: AAA and Majors $290 in both sports). Refresh with scripts/fact-check/README.md before each check.
pulled: 2026-11-03 (re-checked against Sports Connect 2026-11-03 afternoon: no division changes)

divisions.label: AAA

fee.source: board decision: Jason, 2026-11-03 (email); Sports Connect price matches

leagueAge.note: 10's and 11's, plus 9's who assess in; skilled 11's (and a few returning All-Star 10's) may be drafted to Majors
leagueAge.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card

teams.note: 8 teams in 2026 (AAA 1-8 on the schedule), 7 in 2025; cap 96 = 8 teams of 12
teams.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 scheduling chat (BB AAA - 7)

placement.detail: Assessments required, around Sat 2027-01-23, no make-up date. Registering doesn't guarantee a spot: 9's fill remaining roster spots by assessment score, with eligibility finalized in late January; 9's not drafted to AAA play AA. Coaches draft from the scores; order drawn from a hat; coaches' kids placed by score. Siblings: a team that drafts one sibling gets the other with its next pick. Highly skilled 8's are placed here only rarely, if roster needs dictate (kept by Cole in the final 2027 Age Matrix, Oct 30).
placement.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card; John 2026-11-05 (siblings rule same as Majors); Cole's 2027 Age Matrix: Baseball (final Oct 30), footnote 5

siblings.value: Siblings stay together: a team that drafts one sibling gets the other with its next pick.
siblings.note: Applies when both siblings are in AAA (same rule as Majors).
siblings.source: John (registrar), 2026-11-05: AAA works the same way as the Majors draft rule

callUps.value: The top 15-20 AAA players form the Majors call-up pool. AAA teams can call up AA players when short.
callUps.note: NCLL vs NCLL games use call-ups from the division below only; interleague games can also borrow pool players from other AAA teams. The player's parents and both coaches must agree, and a call-up pitches only if agreed in advance (pitch-count rules apply).
callUps.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card; VP of Baseball summary in the 2025 AAA coaches chat; Outline: AAA Division Rules (A3)

teamAssignment.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card

practiceStarts.source: 2026-27 Season Proposed Dates sheet (Practices start - BB AAA: Mon 3/1/27, status Proposed = 2026 date + 52 weeks); Registration Guide; Baseball Hub card

gamesStart.source: 2026-27 Season Proposed Dates sheet (Games start - BB AAA: Sat 3/20/27, status Proposed = 2026 date + 52 weeks); Registration Guide; Baseball Hub card

seasonEnds.note: regular season to about May 20, then playoffs into early June
seasonEnds.source: 2026 60 ft schedule (regular season to May 20, playoffs May 26-Jun 3); Registration Guide; Baseball Hub card

days.note: planning guidance, set with District 8; final schedule after teams form
days.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card

eventsPerWeek.detail: In season, usually 1-2 games (Mon/Wed nights, Sat) plus 1 weeknight practice, most often Monday.
eventsPerWeek.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a); 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 AAA coaches chats

preseason.value: Practice only from about Mar 1 until the first games around Mar 20 (2026: Mar 21; 2025: Mar 22).
preseason.detail: Weeknight slots at Lower Woodland (shared with Majors and softball, 10+ teams a night in March) plus Saturday morning slots; the AAA coordinator posts a practice-schedule sheet. 2026 ended preseason with a jamboree night of short games between AAA teams. Free February ramp-up clinics for AAA/Majors players come before team practices.
preseason.source: 2025 and 2026 AAA coaches chats; Outline: Free February announcement

practices.value: About 1 a week in season, usually Monday, 1.5-2 hours, at Bitter Lake or Lower Woodland (some at Green Lake).
practices.detail: Once games start, Wednesday practices mostly disappear (games take those nights) and Monday practices stay. Weeknight practice slots start around 5:45 or 7:15. Saturday practices when a team has no game.
practices.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell) (2026: 25 labeled AAA practices, 14 Mon / 7 Wed, Bitter Lake most; 2025: 26, 24 Mon, mostly 1.5 hrs); 2025 AAA coordinator's in-season practice plan (chat)

value.saturday: 2026: almost all at 2:00pm; 2025: spread from 9am to about 5pm

gameTimes.note: No new inning after 2 hours, no new batter after 2:15; weekday curfew no new inning after 8:30pm.
gameTimes.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); Outline: AAA Division Rules (D2, D3)

seasonShape.value: Games every week from late March to about May 20, with a weeknight practice most weeks all season; rainouts are made up on open Mon, Wed or Sat dates.
seasonShape.detail: 2026 Lower Woodland AAA games per week: 8-11 most weeks, none during SPS spring break. 2025 coordinator's makeup steps: compare both teams' open dates (Mon, Wed, Sat), agree with the other coach, check the permit list for an open field.
seasonShape.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 AAA coaches chats

springBreak.value: No regular games during Seattle Public Schools spring break week (April 12-16, 2027); fields stay open for practice.
springBreak.status: planned, not yet on the website
springBreak.source: 2026-27 Season Proposed Dates sheet (SPS break Apr 12-16, 2027); 2026 schedule: no AAA games Apr 12-18, 11 practices; 2025: 1 game that week and the coordinator flagged the SPS spring break practice night

playoffs.value: End-of-season AAA playoffs from late May into early June at Lower Woodland (2026: May 26 to Jun 3).
playoffs.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell) (13 AAA playoff rows, 2026)

value.away: a few interleague games each season

fields.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 5; Baseball Hub AAA card; 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell)

format.value: full kid pitch; 46-ft mound, 60-ft bases; no new inning after 2 hrs; five-run limit per half-inning (some late-game exceptions); mercy 15 after 3 / 10 after 4 / 8 after 5; steals once the ball reaches the batter, no leadoffs, no delayed steals; everyone plays 9+ defensive outs; score kept, playoffs
format.source: Baseball Hub AAA card (Game Format); Outline: AAA Division Rules (D2, D4, D7)

familyHelp.value: Families help run the season: the home team keeps score and stats for both teams in GameChanger (the away team brings a backup scorekeeper, required for interleague away games), a parent often handles getting the team's games on the umpire schedule, and coaches and parents prep wet fields.
familyHelp.source: 2025 and 2026 AAA coaches chats; John 2026-11-05 (umpire scheduling is often a parent volunteer's job)

umpires.value: The league provides umpires for scheduled games; getting each game onto the umpire schedule (Stack Officials) is up to the team, often a parent volunteer.
umpires.source: 2025 and 2026 AAA coaches chats (Stack Officials invites, 2025); John 2026-11-05

divisions.datesNote: Cole's 2027 Age Matrix shows AAA practice early March / games late March / end mid-June, but those schedule columns were the 2026 website text left unchanged, not a 2027 decision (matrix status note, Oct 30). No email or chat sets AAA's 2027 dates; the proposed-dates sheet is the newest source (checked 2026-11-05).

leagueAge.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 6; Baseball Hub card

placement.source: Baseball Hub card (Assessments & Draft); Registration Guide footnote 6; coaches' email (John's inbox), 2026-02-01 (siblings rule; John OK'd it for the public file 2026-11-05)

days.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a) + footnote 11; Baseball Hub card

eventsPerWeek.source: Registration Guide Step 2(a); 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats

fields.note: home/away/playoff list is from the 2026 season ('Last season'); card summary says 'Mostly The Cloverleaf'
fields.source: Baseball Hub card (Season Rhythm); 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats

format.value: full kid pitch; 46-ft mound, 60-ft bases; no new inning after 2 hrs 15 min; no run limit; mercy 15 after 3 / 10 after 4 / 8 after 5; steals once the ball reaches the batter, no leadoffs; everyone plays 9+ defensive outs; score kept, playoffs

springBreak.value: No regular games during Seattle Public Schools spring break week (April 12-16, 2027), and usually not the Saturday before. Fields stay open, so some coaches hold optional practices.
springBreak.status: planned, not yet on the website
springBreak.source: 2026-27 Season Proposed Dates sheet (SPS break Apr 12-16, 2027: 'reduce game and practice schedules and permits'); 2026 practice: no games Apr 13-16 in the 2026 60 ft schedule, Apr 11 dropped and made up Apr 18 (Majors coaches chat); 2025 games stayed on and were moved one by one. John OK'd the wording 2026-11-05.

preseason.value: Practice only from about Mar 2 until the first games around Mar 20 (2026: Mar 2 to Mar 21; 2025: Mar 1 to Mar 22).
preseason.detail: Lower Woodland 3-6 weeknights 5:45-9pm and Saturdays, shared with AAA and softball; the Majors coordinator splits the slots in the coaches' chat. Free February ramp-up clinics for AAA/Majors players (10-12) come before team practices. First team practices are weeknights around 5pm (2025: Tue Mar 4, 5pm; a Thu practice around 5:30).
preseason.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats; 2025 Proposed Dates sheet; Outline: Free February announcement; coaches' email (John's inbox), 2025-03

practices.value: About 1 a week in season, on a night without a game (usually Thursday), 60-90 minutes at Lower Woodland.
practices.detail: Teams share Lower Woodland 3-6 (Field 5 most often). Saturday team practices when a team has no game. Rain backups: LW1 (90-ft turf) when Juniors and the high school aren't using it, and the Focus indoor cages (league credits). The coordinator posts the practice schedule in the coaches' chat and Sports Connect.
practices.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats (2026: 14 labeled Majors practices, 8 Thu / 5 Tue; 2025: 17, mostly Thu, 1.5 hrs, LW5)

gameTimes.note: Slots are 2.5 hours; NCLL game time limit is 2 hours or 6 innings. Saturday Majors games go later in the day so wet fields have time to dry.
gameTimes.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (Maxwell); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats; 2025 scheduling chat (Tyler: Majors BB 11am and later)

teams.note: 6 teams in 2026, 5 in 2025; cap 72 = 6 teams of 12
teams.source: 2026 Majors coaches chat ('All six Majors teams'); 2025 scheduling chat (BB Majors - 5)

seasonShape.value: Practice-heavy in March, then mostly games. Rainouts in March and April are made up on the off nights that were used for practice, so by late April and May most weeks are all games.
seasonShape.detail: 2026 Lower Woodland Majors games per week: about 6 in March, 7-9 from late April to mid-May, with labeled practices down to 0-1 a week. 2025: late-April weeks had 7-8 games and no practices on the schedule; makeup options ran to May 30. Tyler (late April 2026): 'we won't have fields for a scrimmage. It's practice or rescheduled games.' Example: a rained-out Saturday interleague game (Apr 5, 2025) was made up on a weeknight at 6pm.
seasonShape.source: 2026 60 ft schedule + 2025 master schedule (weekly counts); 2025 and 2026 Majors coaches chats; coaches' email (John's inbox), 2025-04

callUps.value: After the draft, each Majors team names 3-4 AAA call-ups, who can be invited to that team's practices and called up when the team is short.
callUps.note: Call-ups aren't drafted; it's a discussion between coaches. In use since at least 2025.
callUps.source: coaches' email (John's inbox), 2026-02-01 and 2025-02-28; Baseball Hub card (AAA top 15-20 form the call-up pool)

playoffs.value: End-of-season Majors tournament in late May, some games at Soundview (2026: a playoff game Thu May 28 at Soundview).
playoffs.note: Double elimination, seeding by random draw (Majors manager guidance). Runs between the regular season and All-Star tryouts (May 15 in 2026).
playoffs.source: coaches' email (John's inbox), 2026-05-28; Majors coaches chat (playoff bracket, Soundview fields); Outline: NCLL Majors rules and manager guidance

allStars.value: 12-year-old All-Stars come from Majors (Little League rule), and Majors 11's and 10's are the usual pool for the 11's and 10's teams. Tryouts are mid-May at Lower Woodland (May 15 in 2026).
allStars.note: Matters to families choosing between Majors and AAA for an 11 or 12.
allStars.source: VP of Baseball post in the 2026 Majors coaches chat (All-Star dates and teams); Outline: Majors Division Rules (All-Star eligibility rows)

opponents.value: NCLL is a District 8 city league. Majors plays its own teams and interleague games against other city leagues (e.g. Ballard, Magnolia, Queen Anne, RUG, Northwest Seattle, Northeast Seattle); that's where the away games are.
opponents.note: Interleague games use District 8's rules; the two managers agree on any differences.
opponents.source: Outline: Majors Division Rules (D8 city-league row, confirmed 2026-09-03); 2025-2026 Majors coaches chats

familyHelp.value: Families help run the season: the home team keeps the official book and pitch counts (scored in GameChanger), a parent often handles getting the team's games on the umpire schedule, and coaches and parents prep wet fields before games.
familyHelp.source: Outline: NCLL Majors rules and manager guidance (scorekeeping); Fields Manager 'Protecting our Fields' email, 2026-03-16; 2026 Majors coaches chat; John 2026-11-05 (umpire scheduling is often a parent volunteer's job)

umpires.value: The league provides a plate umpire for regular-season games and adds a field umpire in the playoffs. Getting each game onto the umpire schedule is up to the team; many teams hand that job to a parent volunteer.
umpires.note: Teams request umpires through the umpire scheduling site (Stack Officials) and the umpires-managers group; if no umpire shows, the home team provides one.
umpires.source: Outline: NCLL Majors rules and manager guidance (umpires); John (registrar) 2026-11-05: teams must get their games on the umpire schedule; 2026 Majors coaches chat (stackofficials link); umpire requests in John's email; John 2026-11-05: some teams delegate umpire scheduling as a parent's sole volunteer task

notes.valueForm: A division field is either a plain value or { value, source, checked, note }. Divisions are being converted one at a time (Majors baseball first, 2026-11-05).
